card.title: Weekly Chain Sales Performance Update
card.headline: Chain sales reached €47.23M this week, performing 1.4% above forecast [f1, f2].
bullets: Sales grew 19.9% compared to the prior week, and this was a promo week [f3, f18].
Out of 1113 stores reporting, 47 stores were flagged as anomalous, with 28 above forecast and 19 below forecast [f4, f5, f6, f7].
Same-store sales rose 1.1% compared to the same days last year, with average basket up 4.4% and customer visits down 3.2% [f14, f15, f16].
card.action: Focus support on the 19 anomalous stores that were below forecast this week.

card.title: Store Type C Sales Above Weekly Forecast
card.headline: Store type c sales exceeded the weekly forecast by +16.0% due to holiday timing [f1, f3].
bullets: Sales across 91% of stores moved in the same direction, peaking on Tuesday, December 23 at +39% above forecast [f2, f6].
Daily sales vs forecast showed +14% on 2014-12-22, -1% on 2014-12-24, and +4% on 2014-12-27 [f5, f7, f8].
card.action: Adjust inventory and staffing models to account for holiday stock-up shifts that forecasting tools only partly capture [f4].

card.title: Promo Mechanics Pilot Performance Insights
card.headline: Early signals show 111 stores in the lowest-lift group achieved a +22% median lift [f2, f3].
bullets: Chain pooled causal promo lift reached +37.8% [f1], while the chain median store lift stood at +40% [f4].
Store type b saw a +14% median promo lift [f8], compared to +38% for type a [f7], +42% for type c [f9], and +43% for type d [f10].
Weekly promo revenue at stake in the lowest-lift group is €405.0k [f6].
card.action: Randomize half the group to an alternative mechanic for 2 promo cycles [f11].

card.title: Uncertain Gains from Promo2 Enrollment
card.headline: Promo2 enrollment shows early positive signals, but results are not definitive as part of the lift may reflect a simple rebound.
bullets: The estimated effect of enrolling is +2.9% [f1], with a trend-adjusted estimate of +4.7% [f4] based on 98 newly enrolled stores [f8] and 519 never-enrolled stores [f9].
Alternative models show a donut estimate of +2.2% [f5], while the 95% CI ranges from +1.1% [f2] to +4.6% [f3].
A placebo estimate of -2.7% [f6] and a pre-trend test p-value of 0.0007 [f7] indicate potential pre-existing store trends.
card.action: Review Promo2 performance carefully before expanding enrollment to additional stores.

card.title: Store 722 Sales Gap Investigation
card.headline: Early signals show Store 722 recorded a gap of -23% against forecast over 1 week [f3, f6].
bullets: The weekly gap vs forecast reached -€13.4k [f5].
Customer traffic vs forecast was -22%, explaining 95% of the sales gap [f10, f11].
card.action: Check for local disruptions: roadworks, parking, nearby closures or anchor-store changes (PB-TRAFFIC-DROP v1).

card.title: Early Underperformance Signal for Store 921
card.headline: Early signals show Store 921 fell below its sales forecast for one anomalous week from 2015-07-27 to 2015-08-02 [f6, f7, f8].
bullets: Sales finished 21% below forecast, representing a gap of -€12.3k for the week [f3, f4, f5].
Customer traffic was 23% below forecast, explaining 107% of the sales gap [f10, f11].
card.action: Check for local disruptions: roadworks, parking, nearby closures or anchor-store changes (PB-TRAFFIC-DROP v1).

card.title: Store 1066 Sales Performance Review
card.headline: Store 1066 has shown 3 consecutive anomalous weeks with sales falling 17% below forecast [f3, f6].
bullets: The sales gap reached -€31.6k over the whole episode, averaging -€10.5k per week [f4, f5].
Customer traffic dropped 17% vs forecast, explaining 101% of the overall sales gap [f10, f11].
The underlying root cause for the underperformance remains unexplained [f12].
card.action: Check for local disruptions: roadworks, parking, nearby closures or anchor-store changes (PB-TRAFFIC-DROP v1).

card.title: Store 711 Performance Review
card.headline: Early signals show Store 711 fell 19% below forecast for the week of 2015-07-27 to 2015-08-02.
bullets: The sales gap for the single anomalous week totaled -€8,711 [f4, f5, f6, f7, f8].
Customer traffic was 15% below forecast and explained 78% of the gap [f10, f11].
The store maintains a +48% causal promo lift compared to the chain median of +40% [f13, f14].
card.action: Check for local disruptions: roadworks, parking, nearby closures or anchor-store changes (PB-TRAFFIC-DROP v1).

card.title: Store 909 Reopening Outperformance
card.headline: Store 909 shows an early signal of outperformance following its reopening.
bullets: Store 909 beat its forecast by +36% or €26.2k over 1 consecutive anomalous week [f1, f3, f4, f6].
Customer traffic was +15% above forecast, explaining 44% of the gap [f10, f11].
The store's causal promo lift is +47%, compared to the chain median promo lift of +40% [f14, f15].
card.action: Run a loyalty sign-up drive during the first 4 weeks after reopening (CRM + Store manager, Weeks 1-4) (PB-REOPEN v1).

card.title: Store 827 Outperforms Forecast
card.headline: Store 827 achieved a gap vs forecast of +31% across 3 consecutive anomalous weeks [f3, f6].
bullets: The gap vs forecast totaled €68.4k over the episode, representing €22.8k per week [f4, f5].
Customer traffic explained 89% of the performance gap, with customer traffic vs forecast reaching +27% [f10, f11].
The underlying root-cause classification for this store remains unexplained [f12].
card.action: Split the gain into customer visits vs basket and document what changed locally (Area manager, Week 1-2) (PB-OUTPERFORM v1)

card.title: Store 286 Performance Gap Insights
card.headline: Store 286 experienced 13 consecutive anomalous weeks with a sales gap of 20% below forecast [f3, f6].
bullets: Customer traffic accounted for 80% of the sales gap, running 16% below forecast [f10, f11].
A competitor opened 1460 m away from the store [f13].
The total sales gap for the whole episode was -€70.7k, averaging -€5,437 per week [f4, f5].
card.action: Send a loyalty nudge to lapsed customers in the overlap area (PB-COMP-FAR v1).
